units.source_text: 町子赤着脚从铁楼梯走了下去。

en.t: Machiko went down the iron staircase in her bare feet.

units.source_text: 爬上楼梯的时候，还拿不定主意的新恋情，下楼梯时已经完全死心了。

en.t: The new love she had still been unsure about when she climbed the stairs was completely given up by the time she came down.

units.source_text: 而且，她想第三次新恋情也可以这样压抑下去吧。

en.t: And she thought that perhaps she could suppress this third new love in the same way.

units.source_text: 每经历过一次，就会丧失一次心灵上的美，却能习惯于恋人，这种情况仿佛是为鹿山设置的一道铁楼梯似的。

en.t: Each time she went through it, she lost a measure of beauty in her heart, yet grew more accustomed to lovers; it was as though an iron staircase had been set up for Kayama.

units.source_text: 她心想，今天晚上排练完戏，大伙睡觉之前，如果能为后面那些露宿者们合唱的话，心情会多么痛快呀。

en.t: She thought how exhilarating it would feel tonight, after rehearsal and before everyone went to sleep, if they could sing in chorus for the people sleeping out behind them.
